categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Yuanchen Environmental Protection Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of filtration materials and flue gas purification environmental protection products. The main product categories include dust filtration materials and SCR denitrification catalysts, serving industries such as power generation, steel, coking, waste incineration, cement, and glass. The company also extends into third-party environmental testing services, smart steel industry transformation, and new energy material research through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary technologies including ultra-clean electrostatic bag asymmetric gradient technology, electret treatment, PTFE composite emulsion membrane technology, needle-hole hot-melt coating sealing, integrated dust removal and denitrification technology, PTFE nanomembrane composite, gel silicon-based wear resistance, and various SCR denitrification catalysts tailored for different temperature ranges and industrial conditions. Production is mainly customized based on client specifications, employing strict quality management systems and advanced manufacturing processes to ensure product performance and stability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major state-owned and private enterprises in the power, steel, coking, waste incineration, cement, and glass industries, such as State Power Investment Corporation, Longjing Environmental Protection, Shandong Guoshun, Qingxin Environment, Shougang Jingtang, Baowu Steel, Jingye Steel, Anfeng Steel, Huarun Cement, and Longjing Environmental Protection. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a focus on industrial flue gas purification and environmental protection solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with sales covering 30 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions nationwide. It has also established overseas offices and agents in Europe, East Asia, Southeast Asia, and Arab countries to expand its international market presence. Future plans include setting up overseas research institutes to shift from offshore export to nearshore and onshore production to deepen its global strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yuanchen Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the environmental protection supply chain, focusing on the research, development, and manufacturing of core filtration and catalytic materials used in industrial flue gas treatment systems. It also provides third-party testing and smart transformation services, extending its role along the value chain towards integrated environmental solutions and lifecycle management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in filtration and catalytic technologies, focusing on low-temperature and ultra-low emission denitrification catalysts, integrated dust removal and denitrification materials, and functional membrane materials for environmental and new energy applications. It pursues a project-based R&D system with pre-research and process embedding stages to align with market needs and production capabilities. Strategic priorities include expanding overseas markets, developing smart steel industry transformation solutions, and advancing carbon neutrality through product and service integration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized filtration materials and SCR denitrification catalysts to industrial clients. The company also earns income from third-party environmental testing services and smart energy management contracts, particularly in the steel industry. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, including bidding and negotiated contracts, supported by pre-sale, in-sale, and after-sale services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuanchen Technology holds a strong market position in the industrial flue gas purification sector, recognized for its technological innovation and product quality. The industry is highly competitive with low concentration, but the company has established a solid brand reputation and customer base among leading enterprises. It competes with other specialized equipment manufacturers and environmental technology firms, leveraging its advanced R&D capabilities and comprehensive service offerings to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 524.24 million, a 9.46% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 25.38 million, a significant decline compared to prior profitability. Total assets increased by 3.64% to RMB 1.32 billion, while net assets attributable to shareholders decreased by 4.39% to RMB 614.59 million. The company maintains a stable asset base with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity, despite facing market demand slowdowns and intensified competition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuanchen Technology differentiates itself through proprietary advanced filtration and catalytic technologies that achieve ultra-low emissions and high efficiency in industrial flue gas treatment. Its products feature high dust capture efficiency, low resistance, corrosion resistance, and long service life, tailored for harsh industrial environments. The company offers integrated solutions combining product innovation, third-party testing, and lifecycle management services, aligning with national carbon neutrality goals and providing customers with cost-effective, energy-saving, and environmentally friendly solutions.
